smell: Detector candidate: Markdown link and image destinations are broad S.String fields on exported AST nodes.
proposedTarget: None - keep the destination fields broad and sanitize at render time.

exception.reason: Markdown destinations are not just absolute URLs: they include relative paths, fragments, mailto-like destinations, and intentionally invalid user input that the renderer must neutralize. The trust-boundary code already routes href/src through escapeMarkdownDestination and escapeHtmlUrlAttribute (Md.render.ts:322-323 and :379-380), and Md.escape.ts documents this as the XSS/injection boundary.

smell: Detector candidate: trusted raw Markdown and trusted raw HTML payload nodes preserve broad S.String values.
proposedTarget: None - keep raw payload fields broad.

exception.reason: These nodes are explicitly trusted raw-content escape hatches, and the built-in HTML renderer still escapes rawHtml by default (Md.render.ts:239-241 and :707-708). Adding a narrower Markdown/HTML grammar schema would either be incomplete or would change the package's explicit custom-adapter boundary.

smell: Detector candidate: table rows and table blocks use unbounded S.Array fields and allow empty rows/tables.
proposedTarget: None - keep table collections array-shaped and permissive.

exception.reason: The renderer intentionally handles empty-table and uneven-row inputs: renderMarkdownTable returns an empty string for zero columns (Md.render.ts:186-190), pads uneven rows (Md.render.ts:175-180), and the test suite pins rendering later rows when the first row has no cells (test/Md.test.ts:374-388). Tightening to S.NonEmptyArray would be a public-form change to accepted AST/constructor inputs.
exception.boundary: permissive Markdown table AST and renderer compatibility

smell: Detector candidate: RenderError.adapter and RenderError.message are broad S.String fields.

exception.reason: Render adapters are an open extension boundary with custom names, and RenderError.message is producer-controlled diagnostic text assembled from arbitrary thrown causes (Md.render.ts:287-299). Narrowing these fields risks replacing the original adapter failure with a validation failure.

smell: Detector candidate: the package contains many hand-written expected Markdown/HTML/plain-text strings in addition to schema-derived property tests.
proposedTarget: None - keep golden render fixtures; the additive S.toArbitrary law already exists for Inline, Block, and Document at test/Md.test.ts:45-47 and exercises generated AST renderability at test/Md.test.ts:150-170.

exception.reason: These fixtures assert exact renderer output, escaping behavior, and regression cases. The S5 carve-out allows golden/static compatibility fixtures; schema-derived round-trip coverage is complementary here, not a replacement.
